Qwen3MoePreTrainedModel.excluded: Initialization and backend capability base; no decoder forward computation.

Qwen3MoeForSequenceClassification.excluded: Checkpoint architectures contains Qwen3MoeForCausalLM only; no classification head.

Qwen3MoeForTokenClassification.excluded: Checkpoint does not ship a token classification head.

Qwen3MoeForQuestionAnswering.excluded: Checkpoint does not ship a span question answering head.

serving.notes: vLLM stacks Q/K/V and expert gate/up weights, uses FusedMoE instead of Python dispatch, carries residual/update separately to fuse add into RMSNorm, delegates paged cache to Attention, shards query heads and partitions or replicates KV heads by TP size; compute_logits is separate from forward. No GPU parity or speed claim.
